svg.text: Y0054 / BL(1,0): the quadrant test after H is pulled down -- the quadrants are relative to the SLOT CENTRE, so "TR" is everything right of x = 1.52 and above y = 0.51, including the floor strip right of the slot

blue = pins (K' filled); red = H pulled down (K' filled, hypothesis square at box centre / mid-tilt); black dashed = the widened slot box BL(1,0); grey dashed = its meeter window; coloured thin rects = the centre pieces of each quadrant that survive the exact dead test against every core; one realised pose per surviving quadrant drawn as a square with its centre dot
BL: 36 surviving pieces; drawn pose centre (1.51, 0.50) tilt 0 deg
BR: 236 surviving pieces; drawn pose centre (1.55, 0.51) tilt 2 deg
TL: 32 surviving pieces; drawn pose centre (1.51, 0.54) tilt 89 deg
TR: 182 surviving pieces; drawn pose centre (1.71, 0.56) tilt 83 deg
The "TR" pose sits on the FLOOR to the right of the slot, between the slot and the BR pin, under H; it is above-right of the slot centre only because the slot centre is at y = 0.51.
